en: I am learning Spanish to talk with Rosa.
es: Aprendo español para hablar con Rosa.
why: To talk is a purpose: para.

en: I am learning Spanish because I live in Bogotá.
es: Aprendo español porque vivo en Bogotá.
why: Because I live is a reason: porque.

en: Tomás went to the bank to get money.
es: Tomás fue al banco para sacar plata.
why: To get is a purpose: para.

en: Tomás went to the bank because he needs money.
es: Tomás fue al banco porque necesita plata.
why: Because he needs is a reason: porque.

en: Vale is happy because her sister arrived.
es: Vale está feliz porque llegó su hermana.
why: Because she arrived is a reason: porque.
